label: Он
description: Third-person masculine singular sentences for understanding verb agreement and predicate behavior.

missions.phrase: Он уже идёт домой с работы.
missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Third-person singular motion. 'Он' makes the subject masculine singular, and 'идёт' is the matching present-tense form of one-directional motion on foot. The phrase 'с работы' adds a natural source of the journey in the genitive.

missions.phrase: Он целый вечер читает эту книгу.
missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Third-person present tense. 'Читает' marks the subject as third-person singular and governs the accusative object 'эту книгу'. The time phrase 'целый вечер' shows how naturally an ongoing action sits beside the 'он' subject.

missions.phrase: Он пишет письмо своему брату.
missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Transitive action with a recipient. 'Пишет' is the masculine singular present form and takes 'письмо' in the accusative. 'Своему брату' is a dative recipient that turns the bare fragment into a full everyday sentence.

missions.phrase: Он не видит, где стоит стол.
missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Perception in the third person. 'Видит' is the masculine singular form of seeing, here negated by 'не'. The subordinate clause 'где стоит стол' shows how 'он' anchors a perception verb that opens onto a fuller thought.

missions.phrase: Он очень любит этот старый дом.
missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Emotion plus demonstrative. 'Любит' is the third-person singular present form, and 'этот старый дом' agrees as a masculine accusative phrase. The adverb 'очень' makes the statement sound like real spoken affection.

missions.phrase: Он ест хлеб с маслом на завтрак.
missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Irregular verb in the third person. 'Ест' is the high-frequency third-person form of 'есть'. The additions 'с маслом' and 'на завтрак' build a natural breakfast scene around the masculine subject.

missions.phrase: Он пьёт воду прямо из бутылки.
missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Survival action with manner. 'Пьёт' is the third-person singular present of 'пить' and governs 'воду' in the accusative. 'Прямо из бутылки' gives a vivid, everyday manner phrase in the genitive.

missions.phrase: Он совсем не понимает по-английски.
missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Negation in the third person. 'Не' negates 'понимает', the correct third-person singular form. 'Совсем' strengthens the negation and 'по-английски' names the language, making this a useful real-world line.

missions.phrase: Он хочет кофе без сахара.
missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Desire with a qualifier. 'Хочет' is the irregular third-person singular form of 'хотеть'. 'Без сахара' adds a genitive phrase after the preposition, turning a plain wish into a natural cafe request.

missions.phrase: Он теперь работает дома каждый день.
missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Activity and place. 'Работает' is the third-person singular form, while 'дома' stays a fixed adverb of location. The time words 'теперь' and 'каждый день' make the routine feel real and conversational.

missions.phrase: Он хорошо говорит по-русски.
missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Language ability. 'Говорит' is the masculine singular present form, and 'по-русски' is the standard adverbial way to name a language of speech. 'Хорошо' adds a natural judgement of skill.

missions.phrase: Он точно знает, что делать.
missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Knowledge statement. 'Знает' is third-person singular and opens onto the clause 'что делать'. The adverb 'точно' makes the line sound confident and spoken rather than textbook-flat.

missions.phrase: Он берёт книгу с полки.
missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Taking an object. 'Берёт' is the third-person singular present form and governs 'книгу' in the accusative. 'С полки' adds a genitive source phrase, grounding the action in a concrete place.

missions.phrase: Он медленно открывает входную дверь.
missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Physical action. 'Открывает' is the masculine singular present form acting on the accusative 'входную дверь'. The adverb 'медленно' adds manner and makes the scene easy to picture during repetition.

missions.phrase: Он слышит музыку из соседней комнаты.
missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Perception verb. 'Слышит' is third-person singular and takes 'музыку' in the accusative. 'Из соседней комнаты' is a genitive source phrase that shows perception verbs behave like other transitive verbs.

missions.phrase: Он часто видит меня в парке.
missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Object pronoun form. 'Видит' is the masculine singular present, and 'меня' is the object form of 'я'. 'В парке' adds a prepositional location and 'часто' a frequency adverb for natural speech.

missions.phrase: Он делает чай для гостей.
missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Routine action with purpose. 'Делает' is a flexible third-person verb governing the accusative 'чай'. 'Для гостей' adds a genitive purpose phrase that makes the everyday situation concrete.

missions.phrase: Он несёт тяжёлую сумку в руке.
missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Carrying. 'Несёт' is the correct third-person singular form of one-directional carrying, governing 'тяжёлую сумку' in the accusative. 'В руке' adds a prepositional location that completes the image.

missions.phrase: Он наконец находит свой ключ.
missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Finding something. 'Находит' is the masculine singular present form and governs the accusative 'свой ключ'. The adverb 'наконец' gives the moment a real sense of relief and timing.

missions.phrase: Он постоянно думает о работе.
missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Verb governance and the prepositional case. 'Думает' is third-person singular and the preposition 'о' forces 'работе' into the prepositional. The adverb 'постоянно' shows how a governed phrase fits into natural speech.
